info.title: Game Panel PRO API
info.description: Scoped API. UUIDs remain canonical; server paths also accept global numbers. Current owner privileges are rechecked per request. Native provisioning creates stopped services with central IDs, published templates and per-token budgets. Unknown outcomes are reconciled without automatic re-dispatch. See API-V1-GUIDE.md.

200.description: Page ordered by global server ID

get.description: Cached fleet metadata, no per-row node requests. Default UUID ordering retained; address uses numeric IP and port ordering. Reuse filters with after; restart on invalid_cursor. stale=true forces status=unknown.

post.description: Administrator plus provisioning policy. Durable admission. Same request/key returns same operation; changed payload gives 409. Budget includes uncertain/failed admissions. Token gains access to its created server. Location points to progress. 409 data.status=uncertain means poll, never submit a new key. Installation keys are separate from backup/power.

409.description: Conflict error, or unconfirmed dispatch with data: ProvisionAdmission (status=uncertain) and Location.

schema.description: Fleet UUID or global server number, e.g. 101

get.description: Live runtime detail when reachable, cached inventory with available=false otherwise. No environment, commands, host paths or credentials. Resource sample requires resources.read. Unsupported or missing values are null.

observedAt is the time the runtime assembled the snapshot. Disk measurements are independently cached. Missing or expired samples return resources:null, not zero. Remote runtimes require the updated agent.

schema.description: Fleet UUID or global server number, e.g. 101

200.description: CPU in vCPU cores, memory/disk in bytes, percentages relative to assigned limits

get.description: Names use code-point ordering. Scope and current owner permission backups.read are both required. Inventory is bounded to 2000 entries; oversized inventory returns 503.

schema.description: Fleet UUID or global server number, e.g. 101

post.description: Idempotency keys are scoped to the token and retained across restart. Reuse the same key after a lost response. Different effective name or server with the same key returns 409. An uncertain dispatch is never automatically retried. A 202 is admission, not completion. Read Location with operations.read to check the final result.

schema.description: Fleet UUID or global server number, e.g. 101

name.description: Optional label; up to 64 letters, numbers, spaces, dots, hyphens or underscores, beginning with a letter or number; at most 128 UTF-8 bytes. Empty generates a runtime name.

Idempotency-Replayed.description: true when the same admission was returned

409.description: Different payload for the same key, or uncertain dispatch. outcome_uncertain includes data with the operation ID; inspect panel history before using a new key.

get.description: Requires the same owner, current backups.create permission and a token scoped to this server. Runtime replacement returns 409; offline runtime returns 503 instead of an invented result. Internal output, paths and runtime IDs are omitted.

200.description: Current runtime operation status or explicit uncertain dispatch

post.summary: Start, stop or restart a server (servers.power)
post.description: Requires current server.power permission. Durable at-most-once dispatch per token and Idempotency-Key. Completed means power command confirmed, not game readiness.

schema.description: Fleet UUID or global server number, e.g. 101

202.description: Power outcome recorded. Location links to operation; status completed or dispatching.

409.description: Conflicting key or uncertain outcome; never automatically redispatched

503.description: Admission unavailable; retry only with same key

get.description: Administrator only. Filtered by token policy. Version, name, game, architectures, public port definitions and variables. Scripts, images, mounts and secret defaults are omitted.
Administrator only. Filtered by token policy. No host origins or credentials.

get.summary: Configured game IP and port pools
get.description: Configured pools, not reservations. Administrator only. Plan and install check available ports.

post.description: Administrator plus provisioning policy. Checks published version, variables, CPU/RAM, ports, local images and shared mounts. Does not reserve ports or create a server.

get.description: Newest admissions first. Fields: id, kind, status (admission state), serverId, createdAt, links.self. Follow self for live progress. Install operations require the originating token and current administrator role.
Administrator only. No passwords, sessions or credentials.

post.description: Administrator only. Always role=user. Unique username; duplicates give 409. Reconcile uncertain results using username. No operator elevation, deletion or password reset.

get.description: Current administrator authority and server scope required.

put.description: Administrator only, target standard user only. PUT replaces membership with selected preset. Presets exclude terminal, CPU, IP, ports and startup environment. Repeated requests are safe.

delete.description: Administrator only, target standard user only. PUT replaces membership with selected preset. Presets exclude terminal, CPU, IP, ports and startup environment. Repeated requests are safe.

get.description: Also requires fs.read. CS1.6/ReHLDS with AMXX installed. ETag identifies version. Custom/password entries are counted as unmanaged, never exposed.

put.description: Also fs.read/fs.write. Quoted ETag required in If-Match. Atomic versioned write with recovery snapshot. Preserves comments/custom entries, rejects ambiguous authentication. Missing version 428; conflict 409. No console reload is issued.

delete.description: Also fs.read/fs.write. Quoted ETag required in If-Match. Atomic versioned write with recovery snapshot. Preserves comments/custom entries, rejects ambiguous authentication. Missing version 428; conflict 409. No console reload is issued.

resourceUsage.description: Detail only, with resources.read. Cached CPU/RAM/disk sample; null when unavailable.

Error.description: Structured error; requestId also appears in X-Request-ID
